test_reverse_list: test the DataFrame.reverse() method preserves schema for DataFrames with List and Binary column types
test_reverse_df: test the LazyFrame.reverse() method reverses row order and produces correct expected DataFrame
test_reverse_series: test the Series.reverse() method reverses element order including None values in string series
test_reverse_binary: test the Series.reverse() method on Binary dtype with single and multiple chunks
test_reverse_schema_preservation: test that DataFrame.reverse() preserves the original schema for empty DataFrames with complex types
